question_en: A program change has been made to meet revised process logic. What evidence is required before completion?
options: Verification against specified logic, backup/documentation of changes, and testing/adjustment.
explanation_en: F-30.03 requires verification, backup/documentation and testing/adjustment of program changes.
explanation_es: F-30.03 exige verificación, respaldo/documentación y prueba/ajuste de cambios del programa.
